    "text": "MQTT is a Client Server publish/subscribe messaging transport protocol.\nIt is light weight, open, simple, and designed so as to be easy to\nimplement. Its features\ninclude:\n\n· Use of the publish/subscribe message pattern which provides\none-to-many message distribution and decoupling of applications.\n\n· A messaging transport that is agnostic to the content of the payload.\n\n· Three qualities of service for message delivery:\n\n· \"At most once\", where messages are delivered according to the best\nefforts of the operating environment. This\nlevel could be used, for example, with billing systems where duplicate\nor lost messages could lead to incorrect charges being applied.\n\n· A small transport overhead and protocol exchanges minimized to reduce\nnetwork traffic.\n\n· A mechanism to notify interested parties when an abnormal\ndisconnection occurs.\n\nStatus:"
